subject: Context
source_sentence: The Context Layer encodes C1, Q1 as contex- tual vectors C2 ∈Rlw×2dc, Q2 ∈Rmw×2dc by us- ing a bi-directional RNN (Bi-RNN), where dc is the output size of a uni-directional RNN.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: Matching
source_sentence: The Matching Layer encodes C2, Q2 as match- ing vectors C3 ∈Rlw×dc by using bi-directional attention , a Bi-RNN, and self- attention.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: evidence
source_sentence: The Evidence Layer first encodes C3 as [−→ C4; ←− C4] ∈Rlw×2dc by a Bi-RNN.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: Attention Mechanism
source_sentence: Chen and Bansal used an attention mechanism to extract sentences from the source document such that the summary would cover the important information in the source document.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: Attention
source_sentence: To focus on the query, QFE extracts sentences from C with attention on Q such that the evidence covers the important information with respect to Q.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: Beam Search
source_sentence: QFE uses the beam search algorithm to search ˆE.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: document retriever
source_sentence: Because C is large , we used the NSMN document retriever and gave only the top- five paragraphs to our model.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: WordNet
source_sentence: Similar to NSMN, in order to capture the semantic and numeric relationships, we used 30-dimensional WordNet features and five-dimensional number embeddings.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: ensemble
source_sentence: Our model used ensemble learning of 11 randomly initialized models.
